decision: Abandoned one monolithic order-6 surface graph and split it into seven white-mesh orders plus pial
why: The full trace was killed at 21.9 GB resident memory; order boundaries are part of the source algorithm and expose drift directly
evidence: journalctl OOM record for pid 1665155; packages/topofit/scripts/export_models.py

decision: Selected ONNX Runtime WebAssembly as the primary executor
why: The exported graphs use portable ONNX operators; a CPU browser path is smaller and more auditable than a new custom WebGPU engine

decision: Export each learned surface update once and repeat it at runtime
why: The checkpoint applies identical white graphs twice at orders 0-5 and the identical pial graph ten times; unrolling duplicates topology constants and exhausted memory
result: preserved checkpoint iteration counts while reducing export and download size

decision: Separated controlled inference parity from end-to-end preprocessing comparison
why: The browser uses Niimath Lanczos while OpenRecon uses nibabel cubic conforming, so one comparison cannot identify whether drift comes from preprocessing or ONNX execution
result: two named reports required before activation

decision: Installed the inference message handler without awaiting Cache Storage
why: A job posted during the worker's top-level cache await was delivered before onmessage existed and was dropped
result: red in 10 seconds before the fix; green in 0.917 seconds after it

decision: Normalize exported graph output names to the declared public tensor contract
why: PyTorch constant folding renamed the TReGA template output to a numeric value despite output_names
evidence: ONNX graph output inspection and production browser failure
result: TReGA outputs are targets, weights, templates and CPU parity still passes

decision: Construct zero buffers from live tensors instead of static torch.zeros
why: Static shapes caused the exporter to embed 371426100 bytes of float zero constants in order 6, exhausting WebAssembly memory
result: order-6 graph reduced from 412769251 to 42653077 bytes with identical parity errors

decision: Scale full-grid vertex coordinates into each decoder feature grid before trilinear sampling
